Acme Robotics to Present at the Wells Fargo 2026 Industrials Conference

BOSTON, May 20, 2026 -- Acme Robotics, Inc. (NYSE: ACME) today announced that management will participate in a fireside chat at the Wells Fargo 2026 Industrials Conference on Tuesday, June 9, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET. A live webcast will be available at https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1234 and on the Investor Relations section of the company's website at https://investors.acmerobotics.com.

Investor contact: ir@acmerobotics.com. Media: press@prnewswire.com. www.acmerobotics.com
